findings.title: Examples become material for argument
findings.claim: The focus presents varied examples as forms that can be carried into reception and reworked into opposition: the human disputant can turn supplied explanatory material into a contest that seeks to unsettle its directive force.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers are صَرَّفْنَا at 18:54:2:1, مَثَلٍ at 18:54:9:1, and جَدَلًا at 18:54:14:1. Wider supplied parallels repeat diversified examples and their resistant reception, show the example as a reusable explanatory saying, and describe dispute as falsehood used against truth. The in-pericope 18:56 reader-walk then contacts جَدَلًا with tightly twisted braiding, so the closing human diagnosis becomes the reception operation applied to the preceding examples.
findings.reader_payoff: The two clauses can be held together as provision and response: abundance of explanation remains present, while argument becomes the way that abundance is recombined into resistance.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains that human beings are especially argumentative. The braid is an attributed contextual resonance, not a claim that جَدَلًا literally names rope here, that every example produces dispute, or that target-side morphology beyond the supplied connection Arabic has been established.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch records and exact focus carriers are supplied, but the accepted reader-walk supports are legacy_unbound and marked non-citable, while connection targets provide exact Arabic without target morphology. The relation therefore remains a qualified contextual resonance.
